title: Tupac’s Murder Finally Has a Guilty Verdict. But the Mystery Isn’t Over
summary: After 30 years of botched police work, gangland betrayals and conspiracy theories, a Las Vegas jury convicted Duane "Keffe D" Davis of Hip Hop's most haunting killing. THR's Jeff Weiss spent two weeks reporting on the strange, sprawling trial — and the questions, including Diddy's alleged involvement, that it failed to resolve.
